clips.send: Turgid: firm and standing tall Each plant cell has a big central vacuole full of water (cell sap). When the soil has plenty of water, water moves INTO the cells by osmosis. The vacuoles swell and push the cell membrane hard against the stiff cell wall. This push is called turgor pressure. Millions of firm cells together hold the leaves up, a bit like air in a bouncy castle. The wall stops plant cells from bursting, so they can keep taking in water safely.

clips.send: Why IV drips are 0.9 percent saline. Fluid that goes straight into a vein must match your blood: about 0.9 percent salt (“normal saline”). Pure water would make red blood cells swell and burst; very salty water would shrivel them.

clips.send: Osmosis: water moves across the cell membrane from high water concentration to low, toward the salt, with no energy needed.

clips.send: Why seawater makes you thirstier. Seawater is about 3.5 percent salt, almost 4 times saltier than your body fluids. Salty blood pulls water out of your cells by osmosis, and your kidneys must use even more water to get rid of the extra salt. You lose more water than you drank!

clips.send: Kidneys, guts and rehydration. Your kidneys save water: as urine is made, most of the water moves back into the blood, much of it by osmosis. Your large intestine absorbs water the same way. After sweating or being sick, a rehydration drink (water + a little salt + sugar) helps: the salt and sugar are absorbed, and water follows them by osmosis.

clips.send: 为什么喝海水会越喝越渴。海水大约含 百分之3.5 的盐，差不多是体液的 4 倍。血液变咸后，会通过渗透作用把水从细胞里“拉”出来；肾为了排出多余的盐，还要用掉更多的水。结果失去的水比喝进去的还多！

clips.send: 膨胀饱满：硬挺直立 每个植物细胞里都有一个装满细胞液的大液泡。 土壤里水分充足时，水通过渗透作用“进入”细胞，液泡胀大，把细胞膜紧紧压在坚硬的细胞壁上。 这种向外的压力叫膨压。上百万个硬挺的细胞一起把叶子撑起来，就像充气城堡里的空气。 细胞壁保护着植物细胞，让它吸水也不会胀破。
